title: Chapter 52 — Outreach Sequences: Email, Text, and Persistence
intro: Multi-touch architecture and the value-first touch library.

sections.title: Persistence With Value
sections.content:
Trade BD requires multiple touches. Most prospects do not respond to the first contact — not because they are not interested, but because they are busy. A structured sequence — email, phone, email, text — over several weeks keeps you visible without being annoying.

Every touch should add value. Product updates, lead-time changes, promotional pricing, industry insights. Never send 'just checking in' as the entire message.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating outreach sequences, ask:

Does the salesperson have a structured multi-touch sequence — or give up after one attempt?
Does every touch add value — or just ask for a meeting?
Are they tracking responses and adjusting their approach?
